description: Research FEMA's disaster database (fema.gov) for 'Fire' incidents in California. Specifically, find the 3 most recent 'Major Disaster' declarations matching these criteria. Create a JSON file at ~/Documents/california_fire_history.json containing an array of these 3 disasters with keys: 'disaster_number' (e.g., DR-####), 'title', 'declaration_date', and 'incident_period'. Additionally, navigate to the detail page of the most recent disaster in your list and download one related official PDF document (e.g., a Fact Sheet, Press Release, or Designation Notice) to ~/Downloads/. Finally, create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'FEMA Research' containing the search results page and the specific disaster detail page.
